# mgc_network_vpcs_peering (Data Source)

Network VPC Peering

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mgc_network_vpcs_peering" "example" {
  id = "your-peering-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the peering.

### Read-Only

- `accepter_vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC that received the peering invitation.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp of the peering creation.
- `description` (String) The description to help identify the peering.
- `name` (String) The name of the peering.
- `requester_vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC that requested the peering.
- `status` (String) Current status of the peering.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp of the last peering update.
